The week ahead, November 22 – 28 (New Calendar): feasts, saints and fasting at a glance.

We begin with the 25th Sunday after Pentecost, when we also remember the Apostles Philemon, Archippus, Apphia and Onesimus, disciples of the Apostle Paul, and St Michael, Prince of Tver.

On Monday the Church keeps the feast of the Holy Prince Alexander Nevsky. Through the week we remember the Greatmartyr Catherine of Alexandria, the Venerable Alypius the Stylite, the Greatmartyr Jacob of Persia and St Stephen the New. Wednesday is the Leavetaking of the Entry of the Theotokos into the Temple. The Nativity Fast continues: fish is allowed on Sunday and Saturday, wine and oil from Tuesday to Thursday, and Monday and Friday are strict fast days.

Coming next: the Holy Apostle Andrew the First Called on Monday, November 30.
